summary: A post-commit live codex-cli workflow probe exposed one additional blocker: semantic reviewer and planner requests did not carry workspace_ref, so Codex CLI reviewers could run without --cd and inspect the wrong directory. The driver request boundary was fixed, covered by unit tests, committed, and then verified by a successful standard-harness plus codex-cli live run.

blocker_found.symptom: Attempt 1 deterministic evidence passed, but Codex reviewer reported workflow-live-probe.txt missing because the reviewer process did not run in the isolated workspace.
blocker_found.root_cause: review_task, review_goal, and propose_next_steps did not set AgentRunRequest.workspace_ref, so CodexCLIDriver could not pass --cd to codex exec for reviewer and planner roles.
blocker_found.cleanup: The timed-out probe worktree and its temporary branch were removed.

details: review_task now requires workspace and sets AgentRunRequest.workspace_ref.
review_goal now requires workspace and sets AgentRunRequest.workspace_ref.
propose_next_steps now requires workspace and sets AgentRunRequest.workspace_ref.
standard-harness and loop-engineering pass their current execution workspace into these calls.
Added a boundary test proving task reviewer, goal reviewer, and planner requests include the same workspace_ref.
